create_llm_chat_client: create a vLLM LLM client with CLI args and run single conversation chat inference
create_sampling_params: create sampling parameters with max_tokens, temperature, top_p, and top_k for vLLM inference
create_parser_cli_args: create an argparse parser with engine args, sampling params, and chat template path for vLLM CLI
test_batch_chat_inference: test batch chat inference with multiple conversations and tqdm progress bar
run_custom_chat_template: run vLLM chat inference with a custom chat template loaded from a file
